THE FOX WHO
OUTWITTED EVERYONE.

Reynard the Fox

For nearly eight centuries, one fox has travelled through the stories of medieval Europe. He first appeared in the Roman de Renart, then became Reynard the Fox as the stories crossed borders, languages, kingdoms and generations. Clever enough to outwit wolves, kings and anyone else who mistook power for intelligence.

  • Reynard was never the largest creature in the forest.
  • He wasn't the strongest.
  • He wasn't the fastest.

His advantage was something less obvious and far more difficult to take from him:

HIS Adaptability.

He could read the situation, understand the players and find a way through when everyone else believed there was none.

  • He was not a perfect hero either.

Reynard could be selfish, mischievous and dishonest. Sometimes he helped others. Sometimes he helped himself. That contradiction was part of what made him endure and emerge on the RobinhoodChain.

He wasn't remembered because he was good.
He was remembered because he was clever, unpredictable and impossible to keep down.

Clever. Unpredictable.
Impossible to keep down.
